n: National Academy Machine learning using the micro:bit
t: A six-lesson Oak National Academy unit on training a micro:bit movement classifier.
steps: Open the unit on the Oak National Academy site.
Gather one micro:bit for each pupil or pair.
Prepare a browser device for each group for the CreateAI tool.
Test the tool before the first lesson. The page read does not name CreateAI.
Check that Oak has not removed or replaced any resources.
